licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cover the dominant clusters visible across all states: fraudulent license procurement, practice-quality failures (negligence/incompetence/misconduct), criminal convictions, seal/signature misuse, practicing without or beyond a valid license, violations of statutes/rules/board orders (including failure to respond or report), reciprocal discipline from other jurisdictions, substance abuse or mental impairment, and the residual ethical/business-conduct items (false advertising, conflicts of interest, fee impropriety, aiding unlicensed persons, etc.) that don't fit the narrower buckets.

profession_specific.seal_document_types.rationale: The vast majority of items fall into five core technical document types (plans/drawings, specifications, reports/studies, plats/maps/surveys, calculations/design data), with a smaller cluster of formal submission or certification documents, and a residual bucket for broad or undefined catch-all terms like 'other documents' or 'instruments of service'.

profession_specific.exemptions_from_lice.rationale: These nine buckets capture the dominant recurring exemption patterns: supervised employees under a PE, federal/military personnel, state/local government employees, public utility and regulated-industry staff, manufacturers doing internal product engineering, other licensed professionals (architects, landscape architects, etc.) doing incidental work, nonresidents with temporary or pending licensure, small/minor building types explicitly carved out by size or occupancy, and individuals or firms doing engineering solely on property they own or for internal (non-public) employer use.
